description: The fence (plan §4.7): an unattended ci-improve/* branch may change gates but never the steward or the judge. The ledger coverage step fails such a branch when it touches any path below. typecheck.yml and lefthook.yml are fenced by content instead (two content ratchets in ci/ratchets.yaml), because seeded experiments must edit them. ci/census-allowlist.yaml is fenced too: an exception to the census is a judgment about the judge.
